name: QtilerAuth
description: Adds user management, JWT auth, and project-level permissions. Uses SQLite for ACID-safe storage.

en.description: Adds authentication, roles, and project access control for secure Qtiler deployments.
readme: Create and manage users, roles, account status, passwords, and API keys.
Set projects as public/private and assign user-specific private access.
Supports session cookie, bearer token, basic auth, and api_key workflows.
Use it as the security base layer for dashboard and service endpoints.

es.description: Agrega autenticacion, roles y control de acceso por proyecto para despliegues seguros de Qtiler.
readme: Crea y gestiona usuarios, roles, estado de cuenta, contrasenas y API keys.
Define proyectos publicos/privados y asigna acceso privado por usuario.
Soporta cookie de sesion, bearer token, basic auth y api_key.
Usalo como capa base de seguridad para dashboard y endpoints de servicios.

sv.description: Lagger till autentisering, roller och projektbehorighet for sakra Qtiler-installationer.
readme: Skapa och hantera anvandare, roller, kontostatus, losenord och API-nycklar.
Markera projekt som publika/privata och tilldela anvandarspecifik privat atkomst.
Stodjer sessionscookie, bearer-token, basic auth och api_key-floden.
Anvand pluginet som grundlagret for sakerhet i dashboard och tjanste-endpoints.
